setup_prompt_partnerChannel:
📢 **Tag the partnership channel** (mention `#canale`).
Type `annulla` to cancel.
setup_prompt_logsChannel:
📋 **Tag the logs channel** (mention `#canale`) or write `off` to remove it.
Type `annulla` to cancel.
setup_prompt_role:
👥 **Tag the partnership role** (mention `@ruolo`).
Type `annulla` to cancel.
settings_prompt_partnerChannel:
📢 **Tag the partnership channel** (mention `#canale`).
Type `annulla` to cancel.
settings_prompt_logsChannel:
📋 **Tag the logs channel** (mention `#canale`) or write `off` to remove it.
Type `annulla` to cancel.
settings_prompt_descChannel:
📝 **Tag the channel description +desc** (mention `#canale`).
The bot will use the latest message from that channel.
Type `annulla` to cancel.
settings_prompt_pmCommands:
👥 **Tag the command channel Partner Manager** (mention `#canale`).
PM commands (`+desc`, `+history`, `/partnership`, etc.) will only work there.
Type `off` to remove the limit or `annulla` to cancel.
settings_prompt_pmCategories:
📁 **Submit one or more category IDs** (separated by space).
PM commands will work in all channels under those categories (and in threads).
Type `off` to remove categories or `annulla` to cancel.
settings_prompt_badgeRole:
⭐ **Tag the badge manager role** (mention `@ruolo`).
Type `annulla` to cancel.
settings_prompt_managerRole:
👥 **Tag the role Partner Manager** (mention `@ruolo`).
Type `annulla` to cancel.
